column6: Tree "drawn from forelimb anatomy" fails when worked: all the animals share the same forelimb bone plan, so it cannot resolve a tree. Changed to "several anatomical traits".
Bead simulation checked; works as described.
An individual's genes stay the same is an absolute (somatic mutation); softened to "inherited genes stay essentially the same, apart from rare somatic mutations", matching the file's own Q5 answer.
Bullet 4 (analogy "tells us nothing useful") is close to a strawman but kept.
Branch-length arithmetic (10 vs 300) checked.
Disc equation values 0.91, 5, 9.1, ceiling 10, fractions 0.91/0.5/0.09 checked.
Said search time "shrinks" as prey become scarce; it grows. Rewrote that sentence to agree with the new text.
Said handling time dominates at low prey density with short search time; reversed. Now says search time dominates and handling does not yet limit kill rate.
Haploid island model checked: s=0.2, m=0.01 gives about 4.0% after selection, 5.0% after migration; local allele lost iff m > s.
Anomaly zone claim (4+ taxa) correct.

Bullet 3 listed "low recombination" and "drift" as causes of a regional diversity valley; low recombination alone does not lower neutral diversity, and the file's Q1 says drift acts genome-wide. Now: background selection (esp. where recombination is low) or low local mutation rate.
Interior areas 877 ha and 640 ha checked.
h2=0.4, H2=0.6, R=4 checked.
q2+Fpq = 0.0325 checked.
5x5 block = 20 edge sides checked.
landscapes in bullet 1 is the topic's technical term, left as is.
Steady state I/k: 5 and 15 checked.
Reaction-norm numbers cross and local wins at both sites; checked.
Bullet 2 defined GxE as the ranking changing; that is only crossover GxE and conflicts with the Core Idea. Now: genotypes respond differently, so ranking can change.
Nullclines P=10, N=10 and counterclockwise flow checked.
Selfing 0.375/0.25/0.375 and p=0.5 checked.
Levins p* 0.8, 0.5, 0 checked.
Dice game rates (e=1/6, c=1/3 adjacent) give a persisting mean-field occupancy near 0.6; plausible as described.
ln2/ln1.001 = 693 checked.
Rate <= 0.001, C-D >= 20 My checked.
Bias direction reversed: a shared rate is too slow for fast rodents (dates too old) and too fast for slow whales (dates too young). Stem and explanation swapped to match; answer key unchanged.
Parsimony scores 4/5/6 checked site by site.
Old Q1 calls the metabolic gene a "neutral benchmark" though it is under purifying selection; noted, not edited.
